source: For an ordinary causal Transformer, once positionZXMATH0000XZ has been processed at a fixed layer, adding future tokens does not retroactively change that position’s layer state. Causal masking prevents information from future positions from flowing backward into the representation of an earlier token.
zh: 对于普通的因果 Transformer，一旦在固定层处理了位置 ZXMATH0000XZ，添加未来的代币不会追溯改变该位置的层状态。因果屏蔽可防止来自未来位置的信息向后流动到较早标记的表示中。
